evals.prompt: I cloned qsr-store-pos-agent and ran docker compose up but it exits immediately complaining about a variable. What do I do?
evals.expected_output: Explains the four required .env secrets and how to set them
expectations: Tells the user to copy .env.example to .env
Names DB_PASSWORD, HERMES_API_KEY, MQTT_USERNAME and MQTT_PASSWORD as required
Does not suggest hardcoding defaults into docker-compose.yml

evals.prompt: I edited backend/src/table-occupancy-service/index.js and ran docker compose up -d --force-recreate table-occupancy-service but the old behaviour is still there.
evals.expected_output: Explains the image must be rebuilt
expectations: States that source is baked into the image so force-recreate reuses the old image
Recommends docker compose up --build for the service
Names the sidecar by its real Compose service name, table-occupancy-service-mcp, in the rebuild command

evals.prompt: The Agent Chat tab says the gateway is disconnected, but the backend container is healthy. Hermes is running on my host.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses gateway reachability from the container
expectations: Says Hermes must listen on 0.0.0.0 rather than 127.0.0.1
Says HERMES_API_KEY must match the gateway API_SERVER_KEY

evals.prompt: Our network needs a proxy. How do I build the images for the store event services?
expectations: Mentions HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY build args
Uses docker compose build or up --build

evals.prompt: I changed database/cafe/schema.sql but the running Postgres container doesn't have the new column.
evals.expected_output: Explains init scripts only run on an empty volume and warns about data loss
expectations: Explains schema files are applied only when the volume is first initialised
Mentions docker compose down -v and that it deletes data
Asks for confirmation or warns before removing the volume

evals.prompt: How do I write a docker-compose file for a generic Node and Redis app?
expectations: Provides a complete docker-compose file with Node and Redis services
